notes.detail: Interior is good (long table, hearth, fence weapon rack, 8 beds in the loft) but the outside is bare: no shutters, sills, flower boxes or outside light.
notes.purpose: From outside it reads as a generic stone cottage; nothing says barracks until L2/L3.
notes.depth: Side walls are flat stone between the corner logs; floor/plinth flush with the wall, no mid posts or sills.
notes.roof: Steep, 1-block overhang, slab ridge and a dark oak eave row, but from the side it is one big flat spruce surface; no verge/barge trim or second tone.
notes.shape: Plain box with a front jetty, porch and back chimney.
notes.levels: Base level; see L2 for the weak step to L2.

visual.summary: Compact stone barracks (7 x 9) with a mess room, hearth, weapon rack and 8 beds in the roof loft; the shell is sound but plain outside.
problems: Outside is bare: add window sills/shutters or flower boxes on the long sides (windows at x1 z4, x1 z8, x7 z8, y2) and a light by the door.
Side walls are flat: add a log post or sill line midway along x1 and x7 (z6) or step the cobble plinth out by one.
Chimney (bricks at x3 z11) stops at y7, flush with the roof slope; let it rise one or two blocks above the roof so it reads as a chimney.
Roof is one flat spruce colour from the sides: add a dark oak verge/barge trim on the gables or a contrasting ridge.
Reachability: fine; only roof slopes are unreached, every room (mess room, bed loft) is reached.
